A story your mind can revisit.

01 / CAPTURE

Begin with what matters.

Speak or type a list, passage, or verse. Review the words before turning them into a memory story.

02 / CONNECT

Make the ordinary unusual.

Use association, exaggeration, linked scenes, or familiar places to build a sequence of visual cues.

03 / RECALL

Come back and practice.

Revisit your storyboard, reduce the hints, and practice the parts you find hardest to remember.

Planned learning modules: everyday memory, school and college, medical study, Bible verses, and accessible practice for older adults.
